column1: # Cities: every Polish city of over 20 000 people (GUS, "Powierzchnia i ludność w przekroju terytorialnym", as of 1 January 2021, the administrative division of 1 January 2023 — the table of pl.wikipedia.org "Dane statystyczne o miastach w Polsce"), their names as the TERYT register (SIMC) writes them.

# Districts: the official auxiliary units (dzielnice, osiedla) of the 10 largest cities as their statutes name them (Wrocław and Poznań: the historical districts; Szczecin: its 4 dzielnice), plus the districts the demo shops name (Kazimierz, Nadodrze, Wrzeszcz). Exonyms of the large cities in Ukrainian, Russian and English by hand; every other Cyrillic form generated (okay-facts PlaceForms).
